items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: And Gary Nash and Simmons said, He said, How do you make a press roll?

ctx.x: Covering the world, to tell you the truth about it...

Jazz is over there to stay. On the other side. But they're taking more of the jazz than anything else. Everywhere we went over there there was a jazz group. And now you take these college... American college boys. Every college you go to... Has got a little jazz group. All of them. The reason why I know that... Because everyone that we played a concert... They invited us out to a little gathering they had... And they had their little jazz groups to entertain us. And they're trying to play authentic jazz. See? But…
But a lot of them can't do it. I don't care who they are.
